title: Ketchup, Spicy
method: Halve the tomatoes and remove stalk section.
Cut the Chilies into strips. Remove seeds for a milder sauce.
Put all the ingredients into a stainless steel pan and bring to the boil.
Simmer for 45 minutes with the lid on.
Then remove the lid and simmer for another 5-10 minutes to thicken the mixture.
Pour the whole lot into a food processor and blend with a fine blade setting.
Pour into a pre-warmed bottle and allow to cool.
Use this sauce as you would tomato ketchup, but with more zing.
To make it hotter just add more chillies
